headline: Carraro India aims to reach Rs 4,000 crore in revenue by FY30
hook: Targeting Rs 4,000 crore by decade end
summary: Carraro India has outlined a strategic growth plan targeting Rs 4,000 crore in revenue by the financial year 2030. The company specializes in transmission systems and specialized tractors for agricultural and construction equipment. This long-term guidance reflects management's growth outlook in the off-highway vehicle component sector. Indian retail investors tracking auto component suppliers can note this medium-term capacity and revenue trajectory.
why_it_matters: Long-term growth target set by auto component maker
